label: The Secret in the Basement: B

lines.text: Sugar and Mana hurry down the dark corridor.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: They must've extracted confidential technology from me, too.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: This bunny suit may not look like much, but everything from the material to the technology behind it is a collection of the latest confidential technology.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Which means that this whole competition is someone's ploy to steal confidential technology.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Yes. Without a doubt.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Not only are they after the technologies displayed at the manufacturers' expo, but also the latest tech given to the participants.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: That must be why they deliberately used suppression rounds on the eliminated participants and moved them to the recovery room.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: I see. That's why they didn't want Mustang running the event himself.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: They're using Coin Rush Showdown to distract everyone while secretly stealing technology behind the scenes... That's a bold move.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: The only person who could pull off something like this is the head of security, who's supposedly a high-ranking Central Government official.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: But three questions still remain.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: First of all, why are they after confidential technology?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Right. There's no one to sell that information to.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Indeed. The Ark is small. Even if they managed to obtain the Big Three's confidential technology, nobody would willingly buy it.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: To start a new company? That makes even less sense.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: They'll eventually find out that the technology was stolen, and when that happens, the Big Three won't let it slide.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: If they truly wanted to start a new company, there'd be nothing to gain from making enemies of the Big Three.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Secondly...

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Why did they go through the trouble of villainizing and humiliating Missilis and Plan C?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: You're right. It would've been safer to just make sure the event ran smoothly.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: But there was malice behind their actions.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Perhaps it was meant to get everyone more invested in the competition, including the CEOs,

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Though the possibility is low.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Last but not least...

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Where am I, and why are you here?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: You're in the basement of Coin Rush. I took the elevator here.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: A few of the security guards were lingering in a secluded area for a while before suddenly disappearing.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: My instincts as a Scavenger told me something fishy was going on, so I staked out the area nearby.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Sure enough, my instincts were right. Some other guards kept hanging around nearby, clearly on high alert.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: The ones who got on the elevator first and those who arrived later were all people I'd never seen during the competition.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: They're probably elite guards or trusted aides. Something like that.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Anyway, when they waved their hands in front of a wall, it suddenly opened up and revealed an elevator.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: That's when I rushed in and got on the elevator with them, and that's how I ended up here.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: What happened to the guards who were in the elevator with you?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: I gave them a taste of my Good Night Punch. They should be sleeping soundly right now.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... I see.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Either way, we need to let everyone know what we've found. Not just the Commander, but the CEOs as well.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Unsurprisingly, the signal is being jammed in here, so standard communications won't work. We'll have to relay the information in person.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: All right. Let's hurry.
Mana and Sugar rush to the elevator.
Sugar mashes the buttons, but nothing happens.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... It seems to be passcode-operated.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: I bet it's either 0000 or 1111.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: There's no way they would've made it that easy to access. Please wait a moment.
Mana pulls out a cable from her bunny suit and connects it to the elevator's terminal.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Ooh, are you hacking into it?

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Yes. This bunny suit is equipped with the latest technology, after all.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: If you just give me a moment, I should be able to figure out the passcode...

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Wait. The elevator's moving.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... What?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: We have to hide. Over there.
Mana and Sugar step away from the elevator and hide in a corner.
A moment later, the elevator doors open, and a swarm of guards come pouring out.
Sugar's eyes settle on the guard carrying a bag in the middle of the group.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: ... It's the head of security.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... Is he the one holding the bag?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Yeah. I've seen his face once during training.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Let's tail them...

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: It's me.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Most of them have been secured... Yes, of course. It was easier than anticipated.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: How should I send the information...? Oh, yes. I'll wait for your call.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Please don't forget your promise.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Understood. I'll report back to you once everything is complete.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... That sounded like he was selling stolen data, right?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Yep. Let's jump him. I want that bag.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: What? Wait just a moment. What are you...!

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Hey, you.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: The bag I've been using for years has gotten so worn out that I can't use it anymore.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: So I was just in need of a new bag. Can I have that?

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: How'd you get down here?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: I took the elevator. Anyway, will you give me that bag?

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Get rid of her.
The guards surrounding the head of security all step forward.
*Bang!*
Without hesitation, Sugar fires her shotgun at one of them.
The bullet strikes the guard and sends him flying into the wall.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Have you gone insane?! You just shot a human!

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Don't worry. They're just rubber rounds designed for use against people. They'll only need to spend a few days in the hospital.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Why do you even carry around something like that?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: My job has me dealing with humans a lot, that's...
The guard sent flying by Sugar's shot gets back up.
He dusts himself off while locking eyes with Sugar.
A strange light glows underneath the guard's clothes.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: ... A Nikke?

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: There aren't any male Nikkes.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Hmm... the armor certainly performs well.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: Good. Activate and engage at once.
The security guards lower their stance in unison.
The same strange light begins to emanate from beneath their clothes.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: ... What's going on? Are they all some kind of enhanced soldiers?

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Please be careful.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: No can do.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: My true power shines in the midst of a crisis.
A short while later...

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: *Huff... huff...*

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... Something's strange. Humans don't have this kind of strength.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: They must've been... working out. Whew.
Sugar speaks as if nothing is wrong, but she's actually taken aback.
The security guards are ridiculously strong.
They take the rubber rounds head-on, barely flinch when punched, and even catch her incoming kicks.
Despite taking out more than half of them, Sugar can't shake the strange feeling that something is wrong.
No matter how well-trained they are, they're still only human.
Physically, they should be no match for a Nikke.
However, it's clear that these guards' physical abilities
far exceed those of a normal human.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Could they be doped up on some kind of performance-enhancing drug?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: That doesn't explain this. There's got to be something else.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: You're not going to lose, are you?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Of course not. Looks like it'll take a bit of extra effort, though.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Tsk, if only I had Black Typhoon with me...

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Does it really make a difference?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: When Black Typhoon is beside me, it gives me strength. I guess you cheering me on will have to do.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: What good would cheering you on do at a time like this?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Just come up with something nice, even if you don't mean it.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: I can't do that.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: I've found it helps to just stick to the facts.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: My hopes and wishes aren't what matters.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Sharing them with others only puts more pressure on them.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: I still want you to say it.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Some of us thrive under pressure.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: You can do this, Sugar.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Hell yeah, I can do this!
A short while later...

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: *Huff... huff...!*

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: ... Whew!

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: So? Wanna hand over that bag now?
Sugar holds out her hand toward the head of security,
who looks around at the guards sprawled across the floor.

lines.speaker: guardleader
lines.text: ... Impressive. Any thoughts of working for me?

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: I already do. I'm a security guard.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Right now, I'm a security guard that needs a nice, sturdy bag.
The head of security hands the bag over to Sugar without another word.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Thanks. I'll cherish it.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Let's go, Mana.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: ... Good work out there.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Don't mention it. It was all thanks to you cheering me on.
Sugar and Mana head back toward the elevator.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Oh, hold up. I'll go back and ask him what the passcode is.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: There's no need. I figured it out.
*Beep, beep, beep*
Mana presses several buttons on the elevator's terminal.
*Diiing*
The elevator doors open.

lines.speaker: sugar_b
lines.text: Impressive.

lines.speaker: mana_b
lines.text: Wait, I haven't finished pressing all the buttons yet...
Mana stares as the elevator doors slide open.
Numerous guards appear, all staring at Sugar and Mana.
A strange light emanates from beneath their clothes.
